settings.title: custom jewelry & special orders
settings.subtitle: Whether you want to custom design your own piece, or make a slight adjustment to one of our existing styles, we're here to help turn your dreams into reality! Our team will help at every step of our simple process.

settings.text: Specially designed just for you! You can custom design any type of jewelry: rings, bracelets, necklaces, or earrings. We don't charge extra for the design services, including sketches or CAD designs. Our custom design process requires a $1,000 minimum order, and we require a $100 deposit to get the design started which will be applied to the final price of your purchase. Returns are accepted for your custom jewelry within our return policy, but custom pieces may be returned for store credit only.

Fill out the request form and we will send you a link to make your $100 deposit. Once paid, our design team will get started on your design request.

When you submit your request, provide as many details as you can about your design. Be as specific as possible, and include any images or sketches, so that we can make your piece just right!

Within 4 business days, our team will provide you with digital illustrations of your piece via email, including computer aided design (CAD) images, as well as rendered images, so that you can make sure your design is perfect!

At this stage, you will have the opportunity to make adjustments to the design before it is handcrafted. Any major design changes may be subject to additional fees and assessed on a case-by-case basis.

The final step is to just place your order. Our jewelry team will send you a link to make your purchase online.

Depending on the complexity of your design and availability of materials, most custom orders take 2-4 weeks to handcraft and ship, so make sure you order in advance of the time that you need your jewelry!

Your custom jewelry will ship via insured, 2-day service with signature required.

settings.title: How long does it take to create your own ring?
settings.content: Rings take a minimum of 15 business days. On average, rings and accessories are complete within four weeks. We recommend ordering no later than a month in advance if you have a strict timeline.

settings.title: Can you create a designer engagement ring?
settings.content: We respect other jewelers' right to protect their intellectual property. We will not replicate any copyrighted designs as this would be deemed copyright infringement.

settings.title: Do you only make custom rings, or can I customize other jewelry?
settings.content: In addition to helping you design your own ring, our highly skilled team can collaborate with you to custom design any type of fine jewelry including engagement rings, wedding bands, everyday rings, necklaces, bracelets, earrings, and cufflinks!

settings.title: Will I receive a wax model of my ring?
settings.content: We do not send out wax models of custom rings, as they are incredibly delicate and cannot be shipped without high risk of damage. Most of the custom rings we create are produced using CAD, the best tool we use to create high-quality, custom pieces. The advantages of CAD are that you see an accurate virtual model of the jewelry prior to authorizing its fabrication. You also have the opportunity to request design changes.

settings.title: Can I put a rush on a custom design order?
settings.content: This is dependent on the design and specifications. When you design your own ring, please submit your delivery deadline in your request form and we will confirm if it is possible.

settings.title: Can you make changes to my cad before the jewelry is cast into metal?
settings.content: Absolutely! After you design your own ring, we’re happy to make changes. Before approving your CAD, you'll have the opportunity to make adjustments. Any major design changes are subject to additional fees and assessed on a case-by-case basis. However, these costs will be presented for approval prior to proceeding. Please note that additional design fees are non-refundable.

settings.title: How much more does it cost to create your own ring compared to using an existing design?
settings.content: A custom ring does not necessarily cost more than a standard ring. You can work one-on-one with your custom design specialist to create a design that fits within your budget.

settings.title: How much does it cost to custom design your own ring?
settings.content: Our custom designed rings typically start at $1,000.00USD.

settings.title: Can you replicate a design from an image?
settings.content: We respect other jewelers' right to protect their intellectual property. We will not replicate any copyrighted designs as this would be deemed copyright infringement.

settings.title: Can I cancel my custom order after it has been placed?
settings.content: Once the rendering has been approved and you have paid for your custom ring, we are not able to cancel the order.

settings.title: Can I return or exchange my custom ring?
settings.content: Custom-designed jewelry is final sale and not eligible for return or exchange. We will work with you to ensure that you are completely delighted with the final product when you design your own ring.

settings.title: Where are your custom designs made?
settings.content: We proudly handcraft all fine jewelry within the United States using the finest recycled precious metals and conflict-free Lab-Grown Diamonds and Gemstones. Create your own ring that’s crafted to the highest environmental and humanitarian standards.
